rationale: The reviewer found that every test pair's proteins appear in training. They showed a sequence-free per-protein training-rate baseline reaching AUROC 0.795–0.812, close to the key's ~0.77 and matching PairNet's 0.79. They proposed a protein-disjoint split, results reported by seen/unseen status, and a degree-prior baseline. Their other points (possible homology, no CI, single seed) are speculative or generic, so they don't count as important issues the key misses.
